content.summary: Malibu Boats experienced a challenging second quarter, as reflected by a significant negative market reaction following its earnings release. CEO Steven Menneto described the retail environment as "difficult" and highlighted that both consumer sentiment and ongoing trade policy changes contributed to a softer industry backdrop.
